metadata.title: Quad-Panel Monochrome Portrait with Central Sticker Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A four-way split-screen of high-contrast black and white portraits anchored by a central white rectangular information block.
excludeWhen: a single focal subject is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A 2x2 grid of distinct black and white close-up portraits, where each quadrant features a different individual. A white rounded-corner rectangle is centered at the intersection of the four panels, containing dense, centered serif typography that serves as the primary information hub.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the white central sticker and the dark portrait backgrounds
Uniformity of lighting and grain across disparate portrait subjects
Visual tension created by the central block obscuring the inner corners of each portrait
coreInvariants: Centered text alignment within the block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four head-and-shoulder portraits occupying equal quadrants of the square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white rectangle acts as the primary focal point and anchor for the entire composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central text block, then moves clockwise through the four portraits starting from the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subjects' faces and the central graphic element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and mid-tone grays in the portraits.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the central sticker background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for the typography on the white sticker.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the sticker and the photographic background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Large-scale display numerals/letters for the primary title

composition.position: Middle and bottom of central sticker

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of a single high-contrast serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high stroke contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Provides a similar authoritative, classic feel for the body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2x2 grid of four distinct black and white male portraits with high contrast, gritty texture, and neutral backgrounds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a white rounded-corner rectangle in the center. Add centered black serif text, using a large bold font for the top line and smaller condensed serif text for the descriptive blocks below.

verificationChecks: Is the central sticker pure white?
Is all text centered and black?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the grid
Corner radius of the central sticker
Font weight of the display text

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting across all four portraits
Clean, legible typography within the sticker
Balanced visual weight between the four quadrants

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the central sticker does not have a drop shadow.
Verify that the text does not touch the edges of the white rectangle.
Check that the portraits are strictly monochrome without sepia tones.
Confirm the 2x2 grid lines are aligned with the sticker's center.
recipe.reuseFormula: 2x2 Grayscale Portrait Grid + Central White Info-Block + High-Contrast Serif Typography
